name: Taking Notes to Engage with a Book
equipment: A notebook or a note-taking app
instructions: Try marginalia -- brief notes or reactions in the margin -- if you own the book, or a running notes doc if you do not.
Note down passages that surprised, challenged, or resonated with you, not just plot points.
Do a quick end-of-book review of your notes; it turns a passive read into something you can actually reference later.
Watch today's video for eight concrete note-taking techniques.
